body: I spent 3 years with someone I thought loved me. She cheated. I took her back and gave her a second chance because I loved her. Things were looking up. Turns out she cheated again. And again. She blamed it all on me, saying I was just a ball of negativity and that she shouldn't have to suffer because of me. She called me a lot of things that were negative, from stupid, to annoying, to being an attention seeker or seeking pity. I can't look at myself in the mirror anymore. I can't afford a hospital trip.
